prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1412; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim documentation. Do you understand and agree to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were driving when the collision happened.

A: I was heading down a main road in Katy, Texas, and I was turning left into a shopping center parking lot.

Q: What was the weather and visibility like?

A: It was clear and sunny. The sun was pretty low, so it was bright, but I could see fine.

Q: Describe what happened as you began your turn.

A: I had my turn signal on and I checked for oncoming traffic. There was a gap, so I started to go. Then a vehicle coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see that vehicle before you started the turn?

A: I saw headlights a ways back, but I thought it was far enough away to make the turn.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not deploy, but my left knee hit the dashboard and the door frame.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for your knee?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist. I have swelling and I can't fully bend it yet.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and my knee taken care of.

Q: Thank you. We will be in touch with next steps.

A: Thank you.
